transcript.text: Hi everyone — I'm ready to kick off our clearance huddle for the festival trailer. As we know, the trailer is picture-locked at 60 seconds and going up this week, so we need to settle the music today. Our shortlist is down to "Static Bloom" and "Neon Weather." Before I make the final call and record the delivery package, I want to hear from each of you — rights, label, editorial, and festival-submissions leads. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'll start. I reviewed the executed publishing license for "Static Bloom" yesterday. The composition may be used in the official trailer only for a cue of no more than 42 seconds, with the exact credit "Written by Celia Voss." I haven't yet entered these terms in the clearance tracker, but I'm flagging them now so we all have the full picture before any decision is recorded.

transcript.text: On the label side, I confirmed with the master-rights owner that only the instrumental master of 'Static Bloom' is cleared for this trailer — non-exclusive, limited to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The vocal master is excluded, and any territory outside those three is not cleared. I should note this confirmation is still in my email and hasn't been uploaded to the shared licensing folder yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the editorial side, I need to flag something critical about the locked picture. I checked the picture lock and confirmed that the music cue begins at exactly 00:18 and runs for exactly 42 seconds. Changing either of those timings — the start point or the duration — would require reopening the approved picture lock, which we absolutely don't want to do with upload scheduled this week. I have not circulated a revised music note because the picture lock stands as approved. So whatever we decide on music has to fit a 42-second cue starting at 00:18, no exceptions.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the festival-submissions side, I need to flag a new vendor requirement. I confirmed with the festival upload vendor this morning that the trailer package must include a 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo WAV of the cleared instrumental and a completed cue sheet before the file can be accepted. The vendor added this requirement to the submission portal today. I have not yet updated the production checklist, but given that 'Static Bloom' is only cleared as an instrumental and our cue is exactly 42 seconds, we'll need to make sure both the WAV file and cue sheet are prepared alongside the delivery package.
transcript.speaker: A5
